verdict.rationale: Secureframe embeds task-specific AI features in the product. Comply AI for Risk automates risk assessments (scores, treatment, justifications), Comply AI for Policies drafts and revises policy text, Comply AI extracts answers from vendor documents, and AI generates SSPs/POA&Ms and infrastructure-as-code fixes. These are discrete automations rather than a general built-in assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to; the MCP server only lets external assistants act on your data, so it is not an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product conversational assistant/agent for delegating arbitrary tasks, documentation of how delegation and approval work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
